questions.qAf: Watter EEN van die volgende molekules is polêr?

questions.q: The strongest intermolecular force between water molecules is …
questions.qAf: Die sterkste intermolekulêre krag tussen watermolekules is …

questions.q: The pressure of a fixed mass of gas is doubled at constant temperature. Its volume …
questions.qAf: Die druk van ’n vaste massa gas word by konstante temperatuur verdubbel. Sy volume …

questions.q: 0,5 mol of solute is dissolved to make 250 cm³ of solution. The concentration is …
questions.qAf: 0,5 mol opgeloste stof word opgelos om 250 cm³ oplossing te maak. Die konsentrasie is …

questions.q: For an exothermic reaction, ΔH is …
questions.qAf: Vir ’n eksotermiese reaksie is ΔH …

questions.q: The conjugate base of H₂SO₄ is …
questions.qAf: Die gekonjugeerde basis van H₂SO₄ is …

questions.q: A substance that can act as either an acid or a base is called …
questions.qAf: ’n Stof wat as ’n suur of ’n basis kan optree, word … genoem.

questions.q: The oxidation number of manganese in KMnO₄ is …
questions.qAf: Die oksidasiegetal van mangaan in KMnO₄ is …

questions.q: A reducing agent is a substance that …

sections.intro: Choose the correct answer. Relative atomic masses: H 1 ; C 12 ; N 14 ; O 16 ; Na 23 ; Mg 24 ; S 32 ; Cl 35,5 ; Zn 65. R = 8,31 J·K⁻¹·mol⁻¹. Molar gas volume at STP: 22,4 dm³·mol⁻¹.
sections.introAf: Kies die korrekte antwoord. Relatiewe atoommassas: H 1 ; C 12 ; N 14 ; O 16 ; Na 23 ; Mg 24 ; S 32 ; Cl 35,5 ; Zn 65. R = 8,31 J·K⁻¹·mol⁻¹. Molêre gasvolume by STD: 22,4 dm³·mol⁻¹.

questions.q: Define bond energy.
questions.qAf: Definieer bindingsenergie.
points: The energy needed to break one mole of a particular bond
to separate the atoms (in the gas phase)
pointsAf: Die energie wat nodig is om een mol van ’n bepaalde binding te breek
om die atome te skei (in die gasfase)

questions.q: State the relationship between bond length and bond energy.
questions.qAf: Noem die verband tussen bindingslengte en bindingsenergie.
points: the higher the bond energy (the stronger the bond)
pointsAf: hoe hoër die bindingsenergie (hoe sterker die binding)

questions.q: Write down the shape of each molecule: (a) NH₃, (b) H₂O, (c) CO₂, (d) BF₃.
questions.qAf: Skryf die vorm van elke molekuul neer: (a) NH₃, (b) H₂O, (c) CO₂, (d) BF₃.

questions.q: How many lone pairs are there on the central atom of NH₃?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel alleenpare is daar op die sentrale atoom van NH₃?

questions.q: How many lone pairs are there on the central atom of H₂O?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel alleenpare is daar op die sentrale atoom van H₂O?

questions.q: The electronegativities of H and Cl are 2,1 and 3,0. Calculate the electronegativity difference and classify the H–Cl bond.
questions.qAf: Die elektronegatiwiteite van H en Cl is 2,1 en 3,0. Bereken die elektronegatiwiteitsverskil en klassifiseer die H–Cl-binding.

questions.q: The B–F bonds in BF₃ are polar, but the molecule is non-polar. Explain.
questions.qAf: Die B–F-bindings in BF₃ is polêr, maar die molekuul is nie-polêr. Verduidelik.

sections.title: Intermolecular forces

questions.q: Define intermolecular forces.
questions.qAf: Definieer intermolekulêre kragte.

questions.q: Name the strongest type of intermolecular force in each compound.
questions.qAf: Noem die sterkste soort intermolekulêre krag in elke verbinding.

questions.q: Explain why the boiling point of H₂O is much higher than that of CH₄.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die kookpunt van H₂O baie hoër is as dié van CH₄.
points: H₂O has hydrogen bonds, while CH₄ has only London forces
so more energy is needed to overcome the intermolecular forces in water
pointsAf: H₂O het waterstofbindings, terwyl CH₄ slegs Londonkragte het
dus is meer energie nodig om die intermolekulêre kragte in water te oorkom

questions.q: Explain why the boiling point of H₂O is higher than that of NH₃.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die kookpunt van H₂O hoër is as dié van NH₃.
points: O is more electronegative than N, so the hydrogen bonds in water are stronger
and each water molecule can form more hydrogen bonds
pointsAf: O is meer elektronegatief as N, dus is die waterstofbindings in water sterker
en elke watermolekuul kan meer waterstofbindings vorm

questions.q: Identify the independent and the dependent variable in this comparison.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die onafhanklike en die afhanklike veranderlike in hierdie vergelyking.
points: independent: the type of compound (type of intermolecular force)
pointsAf: onafhanklik: die soort verbinding (soort intermolekulêre krag)

questions.q: Iodine dissolves in hexane but hardly dissolves in water. Explain.
questions.qAf: Jodium los in heksaan op, maar los skaars in water op. Verduidelik.
points: Iodine and hexane are both non-polar with London forces between their molecules, so they mix
water molecules are held by strong hydrogen bonds that iodine cannot replace
pointsAf: Jodium en heksaan is albei nie-polêr met Londonkragte tussen hul molekules, dus meng hulle
watermolekules word deur sterk waterstofbindings vasgehou wat jodium nie kan vervang nie

questions.q: State the relationship between the strength of intermolecular forces and vapour pressure.
questions.qAf: Noem die verband tussen die sterkte van intermolekulêre kragte en dampdruk.

sections.intro: The table shows the boiling points of three compounds with similar molar masses.
sections.introAf: Die tabel toon die kookpunte van drie verbindings met soortgelyke molêre massas.

questions.q: State Boyle’s law.
questions.qAf: Stel Boyle se wet.
points: The pressure of an enclosed gas is inversely proportional to its volume
pointsAf: Die druk van ’n ingeslote gas is omgekeerd eweredig aan sy volume

questions.q: A gas occupies 2 dm³ at 100 kPa. Calculate its volume at 250 kPa if the temperature stays constant.
questions.qAf: ’n Gas beslaan 2 dm³ by 100 kPa. Bereken sy volume by 250 kPa as die temperatuur konstant bly.

questions.q: A gas occupies 3 dm³ at 27 °C. Calculate its volume at 127 °C at constant pressure.
questions.qAf: ’n Gas beslaan 3 dm³ by 27 °C. Bereken sy volume by 127 °C by konstante druk.

questions.q: Calculate the number of moles of gas in a 5 dm³ container at 200 kPa and 25 °C.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aantal mol gas in ’n houer van 5 dm³ by 200 kPa en 25 °C.

questions.q: Under which TWO conditions do real gases deviate most from ideal behaviour?
questions.qAf: Onder watter TWEE toestande wyk regte gasse die meeste van ideale gedrag af?

questions.q: Why must temperatures be in kelvin in the gas laws?
questions.qAf: Waarom moet temperature in die gaswette in kelvin wees?
points: The kelvin scale starts at absolute zero
so the temperature is directly proportional to the average kinetic energy of the particles
pointsAf: Die kelvinskaal begin by absolute nul
dus is die temperatuur direk eweredig aan die gemiddelde kinetiese energie van die deeltjies

sections.title: Quantitative aspects: solutions and titrations

questions.q: Define the concentration of a solution.
questions.qAf: Definieer die konsentrasie van ’n oplossing.

questions.q: Calculate the mass of sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) needed to make 250 cm³ of a 0,2 mol·dm⁻³ solution.
questions.qAf: Bereken die massa natriumkarbonaat (Na₂CO₃) wat nodig is om 250 cm³ van ’n 0,2 mol·dm⁻³-oplossing te maak.

questions.scenario:
25 cm³ of a sodium hydroxide solution is titrated with 0,15 mol·dm⁻³ sulfuric acid. 20 cm³ of the acid is needed to reach the endpoint.
H₂SO₄(aq) + 2NaOH(aq) → Na₂SO₄(aq) + 2H₂O(ℓ)
questions.scenarioAf:
25 cm³ van ’n natriumhidroksiedoplossing word met 0,15 mol·dm⁻³-swawelsuur getitreer. 20 cm³ van die suur is nodig om die eindpunt te bereik.
H₂SO₄(aq) + 2NaOH(aq) → Na₂SO₄(aq) + 2H₂O(ℓ)

questions.q: Calculate the number of moles of H₂SO₄ used.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aantal mol H₂SO₄ wat gebruik is.

questions.q: Calculate the number of moles of NaOH that reacted.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aantal mol NaOH wat gereageer het.

questions.q: Calculate the concentration of the NaOH solution.
questions.qAf: Bereken die konsentrasie van die NaOH-oplossing.

questions.q: Name a suitable indicator for this titration and give a reason.
questions.qAf: Noem ’n geskikte indikator vir hierdie titrasie en gee ’n rede.
points: the reaction is between a strong acid and a strong base, so the endpoint is at pH ≈ 7
pointsAf: die reaksie is tussen ’n sterk suur en ’n sterk basis, dus is die eindpunt by pH ≈ 7

questions.q: Name the apparatus used to add the acid.
questions.qAf: Noem die apparaat wat gebruik word om die suur by te voeg.

questions.q: Why is the burette rinsed with the acid and not with water before it is filled?
questions.qAf: Waarom word die buret met die suur en nie met water uitgespoel voordat dit gevul word nie?
points: Water left in the burette would dilute the acid
pointsAf: Water wat in die buret agterbly, sal die suur verdun

questions.scenario: Zinc reacts with excess hydrochloric acid: Zn(s) + 2HCl(aq) → ZnCl₂(aq) + H₂(g)
questions.scenarioAf: Sink reageer met ’n oormaat soutsuur: Zn(s) + 2HCl(aq) → ZnCl₂(aq) + H₂(g)

questions.q: Calculate the volume of hydrogen gas, at STP, produced when 6,5 g of pure zinc reacts.
questions.qAf: Bereken die volume waterstofgas, by STD, wat gevorm word wanneer 6,5 g suiwer sink reageer.

questions.q: An 8 g sample of impure zinc produces 0,1 mol of hydrogen gas. Calculate the percentage purity of the zinc.
questions.qAf: ’n Monster van 8 g onsuiwer sink lewer 0,1 mol waterstofgas. Bereken die persentasie suiwerheid van die sink.

sections.intro: Relative atomic masses: H 1 ; C 12 ; N 14 ; O 16 ; Na 23 ; Mg 24 ; S 32 ; Cl 35,5 ; Zn 65. R = 8,31 J·K⁻¹·mol⁻¹. Molar gas volume at STP: 22,4 dm³·mol⁻¹.
sections.introAf: Relatiewe atoommassas: H 1 ; C 12 ; N 14 ; O 16 ; Na 23 ; Mg 24 ; S 32 ; Cl 35,5 ; Zn 65. R = 8,31 J·K⁻¹·mol⁻¹. Molêre gasvolume by STD: 22,4 dm³·mol⁻¹.

questions.q: Define activation energy.
questions.qAf: Definieer aktiveringsenergie.
points: for a reaction to take place
pointsAf: Die minimum energie wat nodig is
vir ’n reaksie om plaas te vind

questions.scenario: The potential energy diagram below is for the reaction A + B → C. The energies are in kJ·mol⁻¹.
questions.scenarioAf: Die potensiële-energie-diagram hieronder is vir die reaksie A + B → C. Die energieë is in kJ·mol⁻¹.

questions.q: Calculate ΔH for the reaction.
questions.qAf: Bereken ΔH vir die reaksie.

questions.q: Calculate the activation energy for the forward reaction.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aktiveringsenergie vir die voorwaartse reaksie.

questions.q: Calculate the activation energy for the reverse reaction.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aktiveringsenergie vir die terugwaartse reaksie.

questions.q: Is the reaction exothermic or endothermic? Give a reason.
questions.qAf: Is die reaksie eksotermies of endotermies? Gee ’n rede.
points: the products have less potential energy than the reactants (ΔH < 0)
pointsAf: die produkte het minder potensiële energie as die reaktanse (ΔH < 0)

questions.q: How does a catalyst affect the activation energy and ΔH of this reaction?
questions.qAf: Hoe beïnvloed ’n katalisator die aktiveringsenergie en ΔH van hierdie reaksie?

questions.q: Explain, in terms of bond breaking and bond forming, why a reaction is endothermic.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik, in terme van die breek en vorm van bindings, waarom ’n reaksie endotermies is.
points: The energy absorbed to break the bonds in the reactants
is greater than the energy released when the new bonds in the products form
pointsAf: Die energie wat geabsorbeer word om die bindings in die reaktanse te breek
is groter as die energie wat vrygestel word wanneer die nuwe bindings in die produkte vorm

questions.q: Give ONE example of an endothermic reaction and ONE example of an exothermic reaction.
questions.qAf: Gee EEN voorbeeld van ’n endotermiese reaksie en EEN voorbeeld van ’n eksotermiese reaksie.

questions.q: Define an acid and a base according to the Brønsted-Lowry theory.
questions.qAf: Definieer ’n suur en ’n basis volgens die Brønsted-Lowry-teorie.

questions.scenario: Ammonia reacts with water: NH₃(g) + H₂O(ℓ) ⇌ NH₄⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq)
questions.scenarioAf: Ammoniak reageer met water: NH₃(g) + H₂O(ℓ) ⇌ NH₄⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq)

questions.q: Identify the TWO conjugate acid-base pairs.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die TWEE gekonjugeerde suur-basis-pare.

questions.q: Does water act as an acid or as a base in this reaction?
questions.qAf: Tree water as ’n suur of as ’n basis in hierdie reaksie op?
points: as an acid (it donates a proton)

questions.q: Write a balanced equation for a reaction in which water acts as a base.
questions.qAf: Skryf ’n gebalanseerde vergelyking vir ’n reaksie waarin water as ’n basis optree.

questions.q: Give the term for a substance, such as water, that can act as an acid or a base.
questions.qAf: Gee die term vir ’n stof, soos water, wat as ’n suur of ’n basis kan optree.

questions.q: Explain why ammonia is called a weak base.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ammoniak ’n swak basis genoem word.
points: It reacts only partially (incompletely) with water
so only a small number of OH⁻ ions form
pointsAf: Dit reageer slegs gedeeltelik (onvolledig) met water
dus vorm slegs ’n klein aantal OH⁻-ione

questions.q: Define a strong acid.
questions.qAf: Definieer ’n sterk suur.
points: An acid that ionises completely in water
to form a high concentration of H₃O⁺ ions
pointsAf: ’n Suur wat volledig in water ioniseer
om ’n hoë konsentrasie H₃O⁺-ione te vorm

questions.q: Name ONE weak acid.
questions.qAf: Noem EEN swak suur.

questions.q: Write a balanced equation for the neutralisation of sulfuric acid by potassium hydroxide.
questions.qAf: Skryf ’n gebalanseerde vergelyking vir die neutralisasie van swawelsuur deur kaliumhidroksied.

questions.q: Is a solution of sodium carbonate acidic, basic or neutral? Explain.
questions.qAf: Is ’n oplossing van natriumkarbonaat suur, basies of neutraal? Verduidelik.
points: the carbonate ions react with water (hydrolysis) to form OH⁻ ions
pointsAf: die karbonaatione reageer met water (hidrolise) om OH⁻-ione te vorm

questions.q: Define oxidation in terms of electron transfer.
questions.qAf: Definieer oksidasie in terme van elektronoordrag.
points: by an atom or ion (its oxidation number increases)
pointsAf: deur ’n atoom of ioon (sy oksidasiegetal neem toe)

questions.q: Give the oxidation number of: (a) S in H₂SO₄, (b) Cr in Cr₂O₇²⁻, (c) N in NH₃.
questions.qAf: Gee die oksidasiegetal van: (a) S in H₂SO₄, (b) Cr in Cr₂O₇²⁻, (c) N in NH₃.

questions.scenario:
A strip of zinc is placed in a blue copper(II) sulfate solution:
Zn(s) + Cu²⁺(aq) → Zn²⁺(aq) + Cu(s)
questions.scenarioAf:
’n Strook sink word in ’n blou koper(II)sulfaatoplossing geplaas:
Zn(s) + Cu²⁺(aq) → Zn²⁺(aq) + Cu(s)

questions.q: Write down the oxidation half-reaction.
questions.qAf: Skryf die oksidasie-halfreaksie neer.

questions.q: Write down the reduction half-reaction.
questions.qAf: Skryf die reduksie-halfreaksie neer.

questions.q: Identify the oxidising agent.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die oksideermiddel.

questions.q: Give TWO observations that will be made.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE waarnemings wat gemaak sal word.
points: The blue colour of the solution fades
a reddish-brown layer of copper forms on the zinc
pointsAf: Die blou kleur van die oplossing verdof
’n rooibruin laag koper vorm op die sink

questions.q: Name the TWO substances that must be present for iron to rust.
questions.qAf: Noem die TWEE stowwe wat teenwoordig moet wees vir yster om te roes.

sections.title: Limiting reagents

questions.q: Define the term limiting reagent.
questions.qAf: Definieer die term beperkende reagens.
points: The reactant that is completely used up
and so limits the amount of product formed
pointsAf: Die reaktans wat heeltemal opgebruik word
en dus die hoeveelheid produk wat vorm, beperk

questions.q: Calculate the number of moles of Mg.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aantal mol Mg.

questions.q: Calculate the number of moles of HCl.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aantal mol HCl.

questions.q: Determine which reactant is the limiting reagent. Show your working.
questions.qAf: Bepaal watter reaktans die beperkende reagens is. Toon jou bewerkings.
points: so HCl is the limiting reagent
pointsAf: dus is HCl die beperkende reagens

questions.q: Calculate the mass of MgCl₂ formed.
questions.qAf: Bereken die massa MgCl₂ wat vorm.

sections.intro: Magnesium reacts with hydrochloric acid: Mg(s) + 2HCl(aq) → MgCl₂(aq) + H₂(g). 4,8 g of magnesium is added to 100 cm³ of 2 mol·dm⁻³ HCl.
sections.introAf: Magnesium reageer met soutsuur: Mg(s) + 2HCl(aq) → MgCl₂(aq) + H₂(g). 4,8 g magnesium word by 100 cm³ 2 mol·dm⁻³-HCl gevoeg.
